hints.title: Target Sorted Partitions
hints.text: In a sorted sequence consisting of values 1, 2, and 3, all 1s precede 2s, and all 2s precede 3s.

hints.title: Boundary Landmarks
hints.text: Find the first occurrence of 2 and 3 and the last occurrence of 1 and 2.

hints.title: Conflict Detection and Counting
hints.text: If any 3 appears before a 1, it is impossible to sort via adjacent swaps. Otherwise count locked indices in overlapping spans.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Locates landmark element indices and counts locked elements in the inversion regions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating swap sequences with locked constraints has prohibitive state complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scans the array in place using constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies partition boundaries for small values and counts locked positions blocking sorted order.
